13.Sub-event_summary: During rain night of 19 August, 313th Infantry crossed dam single file; at daybreak 20 August, 314th paddled across, engineers installed treadway; afternoon, 315th crossed in trucks; by nightfall, bulk of division including tanks and artillery on east bank.
